messages:
Priya (sales-eng): Hey team, vendor risk wants SSO/SAML + MFA proof and a role/permission matrix for ACME POC. They asked for: SAML metadata, admin console screenshots showing SSO enabled, MFA enforcement policy (enforced/not), sample RBAC CSV, and a short note on service-account scopes. Deadline EOD Tue. Can we assemble?
Alex (security): I can pull SAML metadata + IdP cert expiry and a short policy snippet. MFA: we enforce MFA at auth provider level for SSO tenants; for API keys we have optional org policy for 2FA on user sessions. Will add wording for SIG/CAIQ mapping.
Jamal (platform): I have an example audit log of a SSO login + MFA assertion we can redact and share. Also can export a sample SCIM provisioning payload if they want provisioning proof.
Caroline (solutions): For the RBAC matrix I'll generate a minimal CSV: role,allowed_actions,resource_scope. Example rows:
- read_only,read,model_configs
- infra_admin,write,deployments/*
Will attach a sanitized one. Also note: service accounts are scoped per-project and can be restricted to embeddings/generation scopes.
security-bot: Ticket VR-4822 created and linked to this thread. Ops runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/VR-4822 :male-technologist:
Alex (security): Preparing artifacts:
- saml-metadata.xml (EntityDescriptor snippet)
- screenshot: console/auth/sso_enabled.png
- mfa-policy.txt (human readable)
- rbac-sample.csv
I'll redact customer names and cert IDs. Sample SAML header I will include in the bundle:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://accounts.redwood.ai/">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>...
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Priya (sales-eng): Jamal / Alex can you confirm we can share SCIM payloads + example logs with vendor without additional DPA? ACME legal asked.
Jamal (platform): Confirmed — sanitized logs + SCIM examples are OK. No PII; we will hash user IDs. Will attach a short statement of redaction method.
Alex (security): ETA for bundle: tomorrow morning. I'll include a one-page mapping: SIG/CAIQ questions -> evidence filenames. Example: 'A-02 SSO' -> saml-metadata.xml, 'A-03 MFA' -> mfa-policy.txt + login-assertion.log
Caroline (solutions): I'll also produce a brief note on least-privilege recommendations for their intended POC (limit service accounts to model infer & read-only storage).
Priya (sales-eng): Awesome — please drop attachments here when ready. I'll post to ACME contact and update the RFP tracker. :thumbsup:
